skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the role and issues arising from management control in organizations.
Explain the use of each management control method and related impacts.
Apply principles to design effective management control systems.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Management Control System Evaluation Criteria Development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop evaluation criteria for management control systems in organizations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Financial Result Control System Fundamentals Application
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the use of basic elements of financial result control systems in organizations.

Develop the use of incentive systems in management control.
Develop solutions to resolve issues arising from the use of performance measurement methods in management control.
Consider factors that cannot be controlled by financial result control in management control.
